correctness.rationale: The equivalence between JR and a q-supported unrepresented voter subset is proved in both directions. Every potentially invalid quota-selected committee creates a distinct ordered pair with q quota supporters and at least q approving voters outside them; conditional binomial independence gives the exact finite union-bound certificate. Hoeffding exponential suppression, the local binomial CLT, and a binomial-to-Poisson limit prove the asymptotics. Executed independent literal-JR finite enumeration plus exact weighted cases agree; tests are only checks and not relied upon for infinite proof.

value.rationale: The introduced DR axiom has NP-complete arbitrary-instance existence; this result gives a rigorous typical-instance transition at m on the square-root voter scale, with a second sharp n^-1/2 propensity window, full committee-count distribution, and a finite all-committees JR-validity certificate. It thus establishes when exact DR becomes efficiently constructible/countable on homogeneous random approvals, a motivated structural quantification rather than a table of arbitrary slices.
